title: How to Handle Mistakes in Your Sign Shop Without Losing the Customer
description: Joe and Liz explore one of the most uncomfortable—but unavoidable—realities of running a sign business: mistakes happen. Here's how to handle them like a pro.
keyTakeaways: Create a mistake-handling protocol before you need it
Train your team on immediate response procedures
Follow up after resolution to ensure satisfaction
Use mistakes as training opportunities for the whole team
